title: Build and relax TiMoCO₂ structure
action: Construct the Janus-like TiMoCO₂ MXene alloy with space group P3m1 (no.156) and stacking O(fcc)-Ti-C-Mo-O(hcp). Perform full DFT structural relaxation using PBE functional in Quantum ESPRESSO until forces <0.001 eV/Å.
description: Initial structural optimisation required as input for all subsequent steps.

title: HSE06 band structure and band gap
action: Using the relaxed structure, perform a hybrid functional (HSE06) calculation to obtain the electronic band structure and density of states. Determine the fundamental band gap (eV) and write it to /app/outputs/band_gap.txt.
description: HSE06 fundamental band gap of the TiMoCO₂ MXene alloy.
output_schema: A single floating-point number in eV, e.g. 0.60.

title: Optical absorption and short-circuit current
action: Calculate the optical absorption spectrum using the independent‑particle approximation and the AM1.5G solar spectrum. Integrate to obtain the maximum short-circuit current density (mA cm⁻²) and write it to /app/outputs/short_circuit_current.txt.
description: Maximum short-circuit current density derived from optical absorption.
output_schema: A single floating-point number in mA cm⁻², e.g. 4.2.

title: DFPT phonons and electron-phonon Wannierisation
action: Perform density-functional perturbation theory (DFPT) to obtain phonon dispersions and electron‑phonon matrix elements, then interface with Wannier90/EPW to build maximally‑localised Wannier functions on a fine k‑ and q‑point mesh, generating the EPW input files for transport.
description: Intermediate EPW input files required for mobility and power factor calculations.

title: Carrier mobilities from EPW
action: Run EPW using the SERTA (self‑energy relaxation‑time) method at 300 K to compute the intrinsic electron and hole mobilities along the x and y directions. Output the results to /app/outputs/mobility.csv.
description: Room‑temperature intrinsic carrier mobilities (cm² V⁻¹ s⁻¹) for electrons and holes.
output_schema: CSV with columns: type,direction,mobility. type is 'electron' or 'hole'. direction is 'x' or 'y'. mobility is a floating-point number in cm² V⁻¹ s⁻¹.

title: Thermoelectric power factor vs doping
action: Combine the EPW‑derived transport coefficients (Seebeck S, conductivity σ) to compute the power factor S²σ as a function of carrier concentration for n‑type and p‑type doping at 300 K. Use at least 50 logarithmically spaced points from 1×10¹⁸ to 1×10²¹ cm⁻³. Write the data to /app/outputs/power_factor_vs_N.csv.
description: Room‑temperature thermoelectric power factor (μW cm⁻¹ K⁻²) vs carrier concentration for n-type and p-type doping.
output_schema: CSV with columns: doping_type,carrier_concentration,power_factor_x,power_factor_y. doping_type is 'n' or 'p'; carrier_concentration is a floating-point number in cm⁻³; power_factor_x and power_factor_y are floating-point numbers in μW cm⁻¹ K⁻² (for n‑type they may differ, for p‑type they are identical by symmetry). At least 50 rows per doping type, logarithmically spaced.
